note: Status in stories.json: Demo paid (50% of 75%), 1 point. The same eNotification job handles ENA and the post-letter reminders (RD1-DR3), so the reminder after the 2nd letter of a UPL notice (stage DN2) uses the same path as other stages; the reminder query does not exclude vehicle type X (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1151). Three things lower the claim: (1) the job is switched off (cron.notification.enabled=false, cron-schedules-prod.properties:236) so it only runs through the manual trigger; (2) the latest-number lookup through DataHive is switched off (cron.enareminder.datahive=false, cron-schedules-prod.properties:48) so the stored number is used; (3) evidence convention: a step whose execution is switched off in the prod properties is rated Sebagian, not Sesuai. The demo remark mentions Vault and 'Vault permission for the api app service': cannot verify from repo. The word DOS appears nowhere in the code; DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo. Real server property values: cannot verify from repo.
recommendation: Claim partially: the number check, validation and exclusion logic exist, but the eNotification job and the DataHive lookup are off in the prod properties. Confirm the cron's real status with the team before a full claim

steps.step: After the 2nd letter (DN2) is processed, OCMS selects UPL notices that need an electronic reminder referring to it
steps.detail: queryRecordsForReminder picks notices with last_processing_stage IN ('RD1','RD2','RR3','DN1','DN2','DR3') (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1114) whose due date (last_processing_date + POS + PDD) falls in the ENOTEDAYS window, with no send record for that stage yet, offender_indicator 'Y', vehicle_registration_type not I/D/V (so UPL type X is included, :1151) and no revival between the two processing dates; it is called from NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:161-162 and the template stage comes from last_processing_stage (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:174-179). A notice that just passed DN2 has last stage DN2, so it qualifies. Partial because the eNotification job is switched off: cron.notification.enabled=false in cron-schedules-prod.properties:236, so it only runs through the manual trigger POST /notification-main/trigger (CombinedSchedulerTriggerController.java:105-108). The real server value: cannot verify from repo. Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-180 (Closed) says 'Awaiting eNotification cron to activate'.

steps.step: OCMS checks the latest mobile number of the offender at the data source (Epic OCMS9, DOS) and updates the particulars
steps.detail: The job calls batchPreloadContactInfo and then refreshContactInfo per notice (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:185-188). When enabled, individuals are looked up in Singpass DataHive (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2710-2730) and the new number is written through updateOcmsContactInfo (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2800-2806). But the preload and refreshContactInfo return at once and use the stored number unless cron.enareminder.datahive is 'true' (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2325-2333, 2461-2476), and that property is false in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:48). So the latest-number check does not run in prod; the job uses the number already in owner_driver. The word 'DOS' appears nowhere in the code; DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo. Vault (demo remark): cannot verify from repo.

steps.step: Notices whose offender has no valid mobile number are skipped and get no SMS
steps.detail: validateContactInfo rejects records with contactError and individuals without phoneNo (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:2259-2290); in the job a failed record is skipped with a log line (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:254-266). Only ENA is redirected to RD1; DN2 notices keep their stage. The logic matches the story, but it runs in the eNotification job that is off in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236), hence Sebagian.

steps.step: Offenders who opted out of electronic reminders (exclusion list) or hold a passport are excluded from the SMS
steps.detail: The reminder query drops id_no values in ocms_enotification_exclusion_list (NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1131-1135); the job loads the whole exclusion list once (loadAllExcludedIds, NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1207-1213) and skips excluded records or id_type P/PASSPORT before the SMS batch is prepared (NotificationSmsEmailJob.java:226-241). The logic is right, but it runs inside the eNotification job that is off in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:236), hence Sebagian. One thing to watch: loadAllExcludedIds returns an empty set when the read fails (fail-open, NotificationSmsEmailHelper.java:1207-1213), although the filter inside the reminder query still screens first. The content of the exclusion list is DB data: cannot verify from repo.
